chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him), and Muhammad ibn Abdillah, and Ali ibn al-Husayn, and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, may Allah have mercy on them all, narrated from Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari, from Musa ibn Umar, from Hassan al-Basri, from Mu'awiya ibn Wahb, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

He said to me: O Mu'awiya! Do not neglect the Ziyarah (visitation) of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) due to fear. Verily, whoever abandons its Ziyarah will see such regret that he will wish his grave were next to him. Do you not like that Allah sees your person and your dark complexion among those for whom the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), Ali, Fatimah, and the Imams (peace be upon them) pray?

key_terms.أَهْل الْبَيْت: The People of the House (Ahl al-Bayt)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) encourages Mu'awiya ibn Wahb to overcome fear when visiting the shrine of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.), emphasizing that the regret of omission outweighs the anxiety of presence. The narration underscores the unique spiritual privilege of being included in the intercessory prayers of the Prophet, Fatimah, and the Imams, a concept central to Shia devotional practice. This visitation is not merely a physical act but a means of securing divine favor through the affection of the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. My father, Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdillāh, ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain, and Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan all narrated to me from ‘Abdillāh ibn Ja’far Al-Ḥimyari, from Mūsā ibn ‘Umar, from Ghassān Al-Basri, from Mu’āwiyah ibn Wahab, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said to me:

O Mu’āwiyah! Do not neglect going to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) because of fear. Verily he who abandons the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.) (for any reason) will regret it so much that he will wish that his grave was next to him. Do you not like Allāh to see you among those for whom the Messenger of Allāh, ‘Ali, Fāťimah, and the Imams (a.s.) pray?!
